content: {"text": "The 2028-01-31 target date is at risk: probability of meeting it is only 17.8%, with a P50 finish of 2028-06-07 and P90 of 2029-01-19 versus a planned finish of 2027-09-22 absent material risk. The single item driving this is PO-1003, the two 3000 kW diesel standby generator sets, which alone cause an expected 97.2-day project delay and carry a 58.0% probability of arriving late against their 2027-12-03 need-by date. Top mitigation: obtain a written confirmed factory production slot and ship date from Konark Power Gen and hold weekly expediting calls. Because the 2026-10-05 order date falls after the latest order date for 80% confidence (2026-02-02), qualify an alternate source or equivalent product for the generators. Secondary actions include fast-tracking the unapproved submittal for PO-1001 switchgear to release it to manufacture, and resequencing work such as temporary power or load banks to buy float ahead of the PO-1002 transformers' 2027-11-30 need-by date."}
